aggregation: Unweighted sums of per-run counts over all four scenarios and 56 seeds; these are not equal-city mean counts.

units.collision_incidents_total: Sum of within-run distinct simulator collision-incident keys
units.collision_events_total: Raw collision records returned by simulation.getCollisions(), summed over steps and runs; continuing contacts can be counted repeatedly. This is not a colliding-vehicle count.
units.rollouts_with_collision_incidents: Number of runs with at least one collision incident
units.starting_teleports_total: SUMO teleport starts, summed over runs and steps
units.ending_teleports_total: SUMO teleport ends, summed over runs and steps

collision_incident_definition: Within each run, deduplicate by sorted collider/victim vehicle IDs, collision type, and lane; the same key can contribute multiple raw collision records over steps.
raw_collision_events_status: Read-only remote aggregation of existing result.json covered all 1,344 runs; every run contained raw event and deduplicated incident counters. No simulation or replay was performed.
crosscheck: All six incident and teleport sums exactly match the existing compact confirmation_rollouts.csv; raw event totals are 26/28/36/41/39/36 for CFCMT/anchor/equal/dense/PP/MP.
scientific_scope: Descriptive simulator diagnostics; no collision-free or comparative safety claim.
